confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer anchors are triangulated from Numbeo's crowd-sourced Wellington figures and several 2026 Wellington and national NZ guides, some undated. Cocktail and wine glass rest on a few Wellington menu snippets and are less certain. Accommodation values are holistic model estimates for a July (winter) stay, not checked against live listings. NZD prices were converted at an approximate rate not sourced from search, so a few percent of conversion error is possible. The FX value (18 Nov 2026, latest found) came from search-result reports, including a third-party aggregator; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Meal, coffee and beer anchors are Wellington-specific, from Numbeo's Wellington city page and 2026 Wellington guides. Cocktail and wine glass were set from thin Wellington snippets and NZ national guides, with the beer anchor used as a check (cocktail about 1.6 times beer, wine glass about 1.2 times). Accommodation is a holistic estimate from general knowledge of Wellington lodging, not a comparable-city transfer.
